SITE SETTINGS get-site-settings reads the settings; these tools do not change them. The site title, tagline, site icon, home page, posts page, not-found page and permalink structure are set by the site administrator in wp-admin. A missing plugin is installed by the site admin. Assigned home/blog/not-found pages cannot simply be trashed or deleted.
notFoundPage is the published page shown for missing addresses; 0 means the theme's own 404. Verify on an actually missing URL, including HTTP 404 and indexing behavior, not only the page's URL. The 404 body is that page's blocks unless the 404 template has a theme file set for "404" in wp-admin. The 404 template itself is chosen in wp-admin; block templates follow template-contract. The active theme supplies design and layout.
